this_title: HAUTE COUTURE IN PARIS, A WEEK WITH ALEXIS MABILLE
trans_title: 巴黎高定时装周：和艾历克西斯·马毕在一起的一周
introduction: Twice a year, the 12 French Couture houses present their new collections. During 3 days, the fashion world meets in Paris: wealthy customers, journalists, models, stars…In 15 minutes, each fashion designer presents 6 months of work…and in the fashion workshops, a real race against time has started. Fashion designers, models, set designers and even concierge services see their daily activities affected, where they play their future during only a few days: following the new star of French Haute Couture, Alexis Mabille, during the most important week in the year of fashion.
